data.gender_notes: Harpreetkaur is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harpreet means 'God's Grace' and Kaur is a suffix meaning 'Princess'. This name is derived from the Sikh scripture, Guru Granth Sahib. The name Harpreetkaur carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sikhism tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harpreetkaur usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It acknowledges the belief that every individual seeks and receives the blessings and grace from the Almighty. This name reflect the essence of Sikhism, one of the major religions in India and other parts of the world, which encourages people to seek and find God during their lifetime.

The name carries the spirit of devotion, faith, and reverence towards the divine, inspiring the bearer to strive for spiritual growth, purity of heart, and inner peace.
